name: Haven Twitch Chat Media
description: Shows inline media previews (GIF/PNG/JPG) in Twitch chat with viewer-friendly controls, per-channel toggles, and domain filtering.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self'; object-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: https:; font-src 'self' data:;
